sources.title: GitHub - zghanw/whisprflow: A local clone of wisprflow for personal use ...
sources.snippet: Why this exists Wispr Flow is a commercial dictation app. Its own documentation and a case study from its infra provider describe a two-stage pipeline: a Whisper-class speech recognizer produces a raw transcript, then a fine-tuned Llama model rewrites it, stripping fillers, applying corrections, and matching tone, in under ~700ms.
